quest.title: Shrouded Vale, Hidden Hero
quest.description: Uncover the secret left behind by Guhua
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, who knew that such a big secret could have been hidden in this run-down Hall...

choices.text: Honestly, I didn't see it coming either.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also, Paimon doesn't think Huang the Third knew about this place either... Hold on, could this be the actual "Guhua Treasure Chamber" recorded in the legends?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Also, {NICKNAME}, look over there! Paimon spies something glowing on that platform!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, let's go check it out right away!

choices.text: Maybe that's why they say you shouldn't judge a book by its cover...

dialogues.speaker: Engraved Inscription
dialogues.text: "...The heavens are unfaithful, and those who seek its blessing and gain audience are rare. Fate is capricious, and those whose prosperity endures are few... They who are favored often find their paths barred, and worse awaits those who are not..."

dialogues.speaker: Engraved Inscription
dialogues.text: "...This monument was left to ask this of future generations. When you have reached a dead end, what shall you do?"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? This sword seems to have something written on it. Let Paimon see...

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions
dialogues.text: "...Caressing the blade, singing I go, to cleave dragons and drink their blood. The divine light, like flowing lightning, like a frigid wave, threatens to smash the mountains..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions
dialogues.text: "...Beneath Mt. Tianheng, I slay tigers, the scaled beast I skewer amidst the Sea of Clouds... When I return crowned in success, we shall live at ease..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's also a stone tablet next to it... Eh? The handwriting below seems to be different...

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Engraving
dialogues.text: "...I originally wanted to leave behind some delicacies here. But the food would inevitably spoil over time, so I left the recipes here for you to cook instead. I assure you, they shall be delicious indeed."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Engraving
dialogues.text: "...Apart from these, nothing else remains. Only this sword and the beautiful scenery."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Engraving
dialogues.text: "...When faced with a dead end, what should we do? You already know the answer."

dialogues.speaker: Crooked Engraving
dialogues.text: "...Do not take... treasure, leaving solely one... henceforth..."

dialogues.speaker: Crooked Engraving
dialogues.text: May my final stand... be a monument...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... These lines here are so illegible that Paimon can't understand it one bit!

choices.text: They roughly mean that he didn't take anything with him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sob* After all this, we didn't find a single valuable treasure. All that hope for nothing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon never imagined that we'd be able to still see such scenery in a tight spot like this, though... It's something at least, right?

choices.text: It's okay. I'll make you something to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Wen the Fourth
dialogues.text: Sigh... To think that after a thousand years of heritage, the Guhua Clan's head doorkeeper must cheat others to survive... What shall we do, what can be done...

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: Ugh... Alright, come on now. Am I not sparing my junior from starving to death while guarding our gates...?

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: #And don't look at me like that. You're always depressed... But you were pleased to see {NICKNAME}'s performance just now, weren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Wen the Fourth
dialogues.text: That fool from before? They get to take a look around for making you some rice with bacon? And I would be pleased about that? I would slap you to death if I were a few years younger...

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: Heh! Your technique was inferior to mine just a few years ago!

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: ...Anyway, listen... Only a few of us geezers are left. What do you plan to do after we stop testing those who may be destined to join us? Take those books with us to our graves?

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: Hah... Just forget it. What's the point of saying such depressing things?

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: Oh, why don't you try the food those kids made me? Hehe! I think it's better than Wanmin Restaurant's fare! Here, take a bite! Just a bite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay! We've managed to lower the water level. Let's go see what's inside!
